CREATE TABLE task_timing_spans (
    id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    task_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    subtask_id BIGINT NULL,
    turn_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    parent_span_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    span_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    actor_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    actor_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    actor_label VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running',
    start_at_ms BIGINT NULL,
    end_at_ms BIGINT NULL,
    duration_ms BIGINT NULL,
    clock VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    source VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    metadata JSON NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
    updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uniq_task_timing_span_id (span_id),
    KEY idx_task_timing_spans_task (task_id, start_at_ms, id),
    KEY idx_task_timing_spans_actor (task_id, actor_id, start_at_ms),
    KEY idx_task_timing_spans_kind (task_id, kind, start_at_ms)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COMMENT='Task execution timing spans'
